native_form.query:
WITH ids AS (
    SELECT reference_id FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.serviceability_eta_details
    GROUP BY reference_id
    HAVING MIN(created_at) >= '2026-10-23 10:00:00 +0530'::TIMESTAMP_TZ
       AND MIN(created_at) <  '2026-10-23 10:01:00 +0530'::TIMESTAMP_TZ
)
SELECT 'V' AS src, d.reference_id, TO_VARCHAR(d.version) AS version, d.request_id, TO_VARCHAR(d.created_at) AS created_at, TO_VARCHAR(d.sdd_enabled) AS sdd_or_type, NULL AS rollout
FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.serviceability_eta_details d JOIN ids USING (reference_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'E', i.reference_id, NULL, i.request_id, TO_VARCHAR(i.created_at), i.result_selected_candidate_type, TO_VARCHAR(i.cfg_pba_rollout_in_rollout)
FROM prod_silver_db.logistics.logistics_eta_instrumentation i JOIN ids USING (reference_id)
ORDER BY 2, 1, 5
